Here is a straightforward 60-minute desk-organizing checklist designed for a group of nine beginners working independently. The goal is to keep tasks simple, sequential, and achievable without prior experience.

**Minutes 0–10: Clear and Sort**
- Remove every item from the desk surface and place it in one central pile.
- Have three labeled boxes or zones: *Keep*, *Relocate*, and *Trash/Recycle*.
- Quickly place each item into a zone. Do not deliberate—if unsure, put it in *Keep* for now.

**Minutes 10–25: Clean and Wipe**
- Wipe the desk surface, keyboard, monitor, and phone with a microfiber cloth and gentle cleaner.
- Empty and rinse any cups or containers; discard old notes or wrappers.
- Check drawers—remove obvious trash and wipe the inside.

**Minutes 25–40: Assign Homes**
- Group *Keep* items by type: writing tools, cables, documents, personal items, and daily-use tools.
- Choose one drawer or tray for each group. Label them with sticky notes if helpful.
- For cables, use a twist tie or small bag; for documents, use a single folder or binder.

**Minutes 40–55: Put Away**
- Place each group into its designated drawer or tray.
- On the desk surface, keep only the top three most-used items (e.g., pen, notebook, phone stand).
- Make sure the power strip and cables are neat and out of the walking path.

**Minutes 55–60: Review and Reset**
- Stand back and check that the desk looks tidy and that you can easily reach what you need.
- Put the *Relocate* box aside for later; discard the trash.
- Take a photo as a reference for tomorrow, then finish.

This checklist is simple, time-boxed, and requires no special skills—perfect for beginners working alone.

message.content:
Here is a simple, beginner-friendly checklist for a 40-minute herb-growing session, designed for a small group of seven.

**Preparation (5 minutes)**
- [ ] Gather materials: 7 pots, 7 saucers, potting mix, trowel, watering can, and 7 herb seedlings (basil, chives, mint, parsley, oregano, thyme, or sage).
- [ ] Place a 2 cm layer of gravel or small stones at the bottom of each pot for drainage.
- [ ] Fill each pot three-quarters full with moistened potting mix.

**Planting (20 minutes)**
- [ ] Gently remove each seedling from its nursery tray.
- [ ] Loosen the root ball with your fingers.
- [ ] Set the seedling in the pot so the soil line sits just below the top rim.
- [ ] Backfill with mix and press down lightly to secure the plant.
- [ ] Water thoroughly until water drains from the bottom.

**Aftercare & Placement (10 minutes)**
- [ ] Place pots on a sunny windowsill (south-facing if possible).
- [ ] Label each pot with the herb name.
- [ ] Water only when the top 1 cm of soil feels dry—overwatering kills more herbs than underwatering.
- [ ] Pinch off any flower buds to encourage leafy growth.

**Cleanup & Wrap-up (5 minutes)**
- [ ] Wipe down surfaces and wash tools.
- [ ] Distribute a simple care sheet: daily light check, weekly feeding (diluted liquid fertilizer), and harvest by snipping outer leaves first.

This structure keeps everyone on task, with clear milestones every 5–10 minutes.
